name: @sos-2/project-realization
description: SOS 2.0 Project Realization (Work Order P13): repository realization strictly through the P9 action gateway. Typed plans for what the realized repository must contain (workspace scaffold, per-task output commits, branch, pull request, deployment integration), executed EXCLUSIVELY through ActionGateway families (commit, push, pull-request, deployment, rollback) with action-time CURRENT authority re-evaluation, client-supplied deterministic idempotency keys and evidence ids per action — NEVER a direct filesystem, git-CLI or deployment-API call in library code (the composition root injects the reference executors; real providers attach behind the P9 executor seam without contract change). Every realization step answers a typed outcome: REALIZED, DENIED (authority, fail-closed) or FAILED (retryable executor failure) — honest statuses, no fabricated success. Determinism: no Date.now/Math.random/fetch/process.env/ambient timers/child_process in src — the gateway's injected clock stamps every action.
